name: Kosuke Kisakata
main_effect:
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Main] ＜Mind Link＞ to 1 of your Digimon with the [X Antibody] or [SoC] trait. (Place this Tamer as that Digimon's bottom digivolution card if there are no Tamer cards in its digivolution cards.)
source_effect:
[All Turns] While this Digimon has the [X Antibody] or [SoC] trait, it gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[End of All Turns] You may play 1 [Kosuke Kisakata] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
